find:
if (e.type === 'keydown' && !e.repeat) pressedAt.set(key, e.timeStamp);
      const began = pressedAt.get(key);
why: The guard judges a press by when its first keydown was stamped (issue #919). Never recording it makes every press look unseen, so every Enter and Space is cancelled: the keyboard could no longer press any menu button at all.
